definitions.explanation: True to the original, not imitation or amateur.
Complete or thorough, not preliminary or partial.

examples.japanese: {本格的|ほんかくてき}なイタリア{料理|りょうり}を{食|た}べた。
{本格的|ほんかくてき}な{道具|どうぐ}を{揃|そろ}えてキャンプに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I got proper gear and went camping.

examples.japanese: {本格的|ほんかくてき}な{抹茶|まっちゃ}を{飲|の}んでみたい。
examples.english: I want to try drinking authentic matcha.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{本格的|ほんかくてき}なインドカレーが{食|た}べられる。
examples.english: You can eat authentic Indian curry at this restaurant.

examples.japanese: {本格的|ほんかくてき}な{夏|なつ}が{始|はじ}まった。
{本格的|ほんかくてき}に{勉強|べんきょう}を{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: I'm going to start studying seriously.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{本格的|ほんかくてき}にプロジェクトが{動|うご}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The project will start moving in earnest next month.

notes:
{本格的|ほんかくてき} describes something authentic, genuine, or done in a serious/full-scale manner.

WORD FORMATION:
{本格|ほんかく} (authentic/proper form) + {的|てき} (suffix forming na-adjectives)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {本格的|ほんかくてき}に (seriously, in earnest)
- Noun: {本格|ほんかく} (the real thing, authentic style)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}な{料理|りょうり}: authentic cuisine
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}な{夏|なつ}: real summer (as opposed to early hints of summer)
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}に{始|はじ}まる: to begin in earnest
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to tackle seriously

USAGE:
Sense 1 (authentic) often describes food, art, or skills. Sense 2 (full-scale) describes seasons, events, or efforts ramping up to their peak.
